text:
maria: Noticed burst of Gi1/0/17 flaps on ToR-17 (eu-west-2 rack43) around 08:12 UTC. TX errors + drops rising, a few dedicated allocations preempted.
liam: any BGP churn or just link down/up?
maria: only LINK events in switch syslog: '%LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface Gi1/0/17, changed state to down' repeated. no bgp adj loss.
josh: impact: ~6 dedicated instances with high tail p95, 3 preempted. SLO alerts fired.
anya: we already have a soft-quarantine flow but no trigger from ToR events. can we auto-tag allocations on that rack to route through fallback-egress?
maria: proposal: detector pipeline (syslog -> kinesis -> lambda) emits flap event; allocator service tags live allocations with 'egress_quarantine=tor-17' TTL 5m; egress-proxy respects tag and shifts traffic to fallback gw.
liam: +1 but need opt-out for strict dedicated customers and cost attribution. also canary first.
netops: ToR route-map edits require maint window. prefer infra-based tagging + proxy steering (no ToR change).
josh: fallback headroom ~30% in eu-west-2, canary on 3 non-critical tenants for 10m. I'll reserve capacity and observe.
anya: add annotation check: skip tagging if 'dedicated:strict=true'.
sre-bot: runbook updated: 'tor-flap auto-quarantine' created. Steps: detect -> tag -> monitor 10m -> untag -> escalate if recurring.
maria: action items: I will open PR for lambda + parser + test harness. anya to validate allocator hook, netops to prepare proxy acceptance, josh to run canary tonight 22:00 UTC.
liam: add metrics 'infra.egress_quarantine.applied{tor="tor-17"}' and billing tag 'egress_quarantine=true'.
maria: will include metrics and PR link when ready. Closing thread unless new flaps appear.
